label: Healthy Baseline
description: Optimal physiological state with all biological markers within expected healthy ranges. Homeostasis is maintained.
causes: Balanced diet, regular exercise, adequate sleep, and low stress.
complications: Long-term neglect of homeostasis can lead to metabolic syndrome or cardiovascular drift.
vital_signs: BP: 120/80 mmHg, HR: 72 BPM, SpO2: 99%, RR: 14/min, Temp: 36.6°C
visual_prompt: A balanced clinical scale with a glowing golden core, set against a dark grid background with steady, flowing pulse waves.
visuals_inspirations: Inspired by the Homeostasis Theory panel in MedLabs Cardio, synthesizing the concept of equilibrium as a stable energetic core linked to systemic pulse consistency.

treatment.title: Maintenance
treatment.desc: Continue current dietary and activity levels to sustain homeostasis.

treatment.title: Monitoring
treatment.desc: Routine bi-annual metabolic screening recommended.

label: Hyperglycemia
description: Also known as hyperglycemia, this condition occurs when there is too much sugar in the blood.
causes: Low insulin, excessive carb intake, stress, or lack of exercise.
emergency: Seek care if you experience fruity-smelling breath, vomiting, or confusion (signs of DKA).
complications: Diabetic Ketoacidosis (DKA), Hyperosmolar Hyperglycemic State (HHS), and long-term microvascular damage.
vital_signs: BP: 145/95 mmHg, HR: 88 BPM, SpO2: 98%, RR: 18/min, Temp: 37.1°C
visual_prompt: Cross-section of a capillary vessel showing high density of glowing glucose crystals leading to osmotic fluid shifts visualized as outward blue flow vectors.
visuals_inspirations: Derived from BioLabs Cellular Transport (Osmosis) module, rephrased to emphasize how high solute concentration (glucose) forces destructive fluid displacement across membranes.

treatment.title: Hydration
treatment.desc: Aggressive fluid replacement to dilute blood glucose and encourage renal excretion.

treatment.title: Insulin Therapy
treatment.desc: Administer rapid-acting insulin according to sliding scale protocols.

treatment.title: Electrolyte Check
treatment.desc: Monitor potassium levels as insulin therapy shifts ions intracellularly.

label: Fatigue
description: A lingering feeling of tiredness or lack of energy that doesn’t improve with rest.
causes: Anemia, thyroid issues, poor sleep, or chronic stress.
emergency: Sudden, extreme fatigue with chest pain or shortness of breath.
complications: Cognitive impairment, increased risk of accidents, and potential cardiovascular strain if underlying anemia persists.
vital_signs: BP: 110/70 mmHg, HR: 65 BPM, SpO2: 97%, RR: 12/min, Temp: 36.4°C
visual_prompt: A stack of pale, de-saturated red blood cells next to a fading clinical energy meter, with sparks of ATP depletion shown as scattered static.
visuals_inspirations: Combining MedLabs Anemia visualizations with BioLabs Bioenergetics, synthesizing a visual metaphor for metabolic power failure at the cellular level.

treatment.title: Nutritional Support
treatment.desc: Iron and Vitamin B12 supplementation if deficiencies are confirmed.

treatment.title: Sleep Hygiene
treatment.desc: Implement strict circadian rhythm synchronization and sleep environment optimization.

treatment.title: Stress Reduction
treatment.desc: Evaluate cortisol rhythm and implement mindfulness-based stress reduction.

label: Dyspnea
description: Shortness of breath or difficulty breathing, making it hard to get enough air.
causes: Asthma, pneumonia, heart failure, or intense anxiety.
emergency: Blue lips/nails, inability to speak in full sentences, or sudden onset.
complications: Hypoxemic respiratory failure, respiratory acidosis, and potential cardiac arrest.
vital_signs: BP: 135/85 mmHg, HR: 110 BPM, SpO2: 92%, RR: 28/min, Temp: 37.5°C
visual_prompt: An anatomical alveolus schematic with glowing orange oxygen exchange pathways narrowing and being blocked by heavy grey translucent veils of resistance.
visuals_inspirations: Integrated from BioLabs Respiratory Physiology (Alveolar Exchange), rephrasing the concept of increased diffusion distance and airway resistance as physical visual obstructions.

treatment.title: Oxygenation
treatment.desc: Immediate supplemental oxygen via nasal cannula or high-flow mask to maintain SpO2 >94%.

treatment.title: Positioning
treatment.desc: Place patient in High-Fowler's position to maximize lung expansion.

treatment.title: Medication
treatment.desc: Bronchodilators or steroids as indicated by underlying etiology.

label: Arrhythmia
description: Irregular heartbeat that can lead to poor blood flow and cardiovascular instability.
causes: Heart disease, electrolyte imbalance, stress, caffeine overload.
emergency: Loss of consciousness, severe chest pain.
complications: Stroke (from thromboembolism), Heart Failure, and Sudden Cardiac Death.
vital_signs: BP: 150/100 mmHg, HR: 135 BPM (Irregular), SpO2: 95%, RR: 20/min, Temp: 36.8°C
visual_prompt: Heart silhouette with chaotic, jagged red electrical pulses overriding the glowing cyan SA-node signal, showing signal fragmentation across the atria.
visuals_inspirations: Synthesized from MedLabs Cardiology (ECG/Pacing) and BioLabs Signal Transduction, rephrased to visualize electrical interference and loss of rhythmicity.

treatment.title: Rate Control
treatment.desc: Beta-blockers or calcium channel blockers to control rapid ventricular response.

treatment.title: Anticoagulation
treatment.desc: Long-term stroke prevention based on CHADS2-VASc score.

treatment.title: Cardioversion
treatment.desc: Synchronized electrical cardioversion if hemodynamically unstable.

label: Acute Kidney Injury
description: Sudden episode of kidney failure or kidney damage that limits the body's ability to filter waste.
causes: Decreased blood flow, direct damage to kidneys, blockage of urinary tract.
emergency: Seizures, coma, or chest pain due to fluid lining the heart.
complications: Hyperkalemia, Pulmonary Edema, and Metabolic Acidosis.
vital_signs: BP: 160/105 mmHg, HR: 95 BPM, SpO2: 94%, RR: 22/min, Temp: 37.0°C
visual_prompt: Detailed nephron filtration barrier showing a 'clogged' mesh with red warning auras around the Bowman's capsule and toxic ion accumulation.
visuals_inspirations: Inspired by BioLabs Renal Physiology filtration visuals, rephrasing glomerular damage as a mechanical mesh failure with associated chemical 'toxicity' glow.

treatment.title: Fluid Management
treatment.desc: Strict Input/Output monitoring and loop diuretics if hypervolemic.

treatment.title: Ion Exchange
treatment.desc: Potassium-binding resins or insulin/dextrose to manage life-threatening hyperkalemia.

treatment.title: Dialysis
treatment.desc: Renal Replacement Therapy (RRT) if refractory to medical management.

label: Peripheral Neuropathy
description: Nerve damage affecting the peripheral nervous system, causing pain and signaling disruption.
causes: Diabetes, chemotherapy, autoimmune diseases, vitamin deficiencies.
emergency: Sudden onset of severe weakness or spread of symptoms to breathing muscles.
complications: Charcot foot, chronic ulceration, and increased fall risk due to loss of proprioception.
vital_signs: BP: 130/85 mmHg, HR: 75 BPM, SpO2: 98%, RR: 16/min, Temp: 36.5°C
visual_prompt: A long axon with visible cracks in the myelin sheath, showing 'flickering' and 'static' pulses instead of clean signal waves traveling toward a peripheral limb.
visuals_inspirations: Synthesized from BioLabs Neuroscience (Neuron integrity) and MedLabs Neurology, rephrasing the loss of insulation (myelin) as an electrical 'leak' or 'static' interference.

treatment.title: Glycemic Control
treatment.desc: Intensive blood sugar monitoring to halt progression of nerve damage.

treatment.title: Neuropathic Pain
treatment.desc: Gabapentinoids or SNRIs for symptomatic pain management.

treatment.title: Podiatric Care
treatment.desc: Daily foot inspections and specialized orthotic support to prevent structural damage.

label: Hypothyroidism
description: A condition where the thyroid gland doesn't produce enough thyroid hormone, slowing down metabolic processes.
causes: Hashimoto's disease, iodine deficiency, or pituitary disorders.
emergency: Extreme lethargy leading to confusion or low body temperature (Myxedema coma).
complications: Heart disease, goiter, and mental health issues.
vital_signs: BP: 115/75 mmHg, HR: 58 BPM, SpO2: 98%, RR: 12/min, Temp: 36.1°C
visual_prompt: A glowing thyroid butterfly-shaped gland with fading orange energy ripples, surrounded by slow, sluggish blue metabolic vectors.
visuals_inspirations: Inspired by BioLabs Endocrine System, visualizing metabolic slowdown as a cooling, decelerating physical flow.

treatment.title: Levothyroxine
treatment.desc: Oral synthetic T4 hormone replacement therapy, taken daily.

treatment.title: Iodine Monitor
treatment.desc: Evaluate dietary iodine intake if Hashimoto's is ruled out.

label: Iron Deficiency Anemia
description: Lack of healthy red blood cells due to insufficient iron, leading to reduced oxygen delivery to tissues.
causes: Blood loss, poor iron intake, or inability to absorb iron.
emergency: Severe shortness of breath, fainting, or chest pain.
complications: Heart problems, pregnancy complications, and growth issues in children.
vital_signs: BP: 105/65 mmHg, HR: 92 BPM, SpO2: 96%, RR: 18/min, Temp: 36.5°C
visual_prompt: Small, pale red blood cells (microcytic) floating in a thin, watery stream with low iron-glowing particles.
visuals_inspirations: Based on MedLabs Hematology morphology labs, emphasizing the physical changes in RBC size and hemoglobin density.

treatment.title: Iron Supplementation
treatment.desc: Oral ferrous sulfate or intravenous iron sucrose depending on severity.

treatment.title: Vitamin C Intake
treatment.desc: Increase ascorbic acid intake to enhance non-heme iron absorption.

label: Asthma Exacerbation
description: Acute narrowing of the airways due to inflammation and muscle contraction.
causes: Allergens, smoke, exercise, or viral infections.
emergency: Silent chest (no air movement), gasping, or bluish tint to face.
complications: Status asthmaticus, respiratory failure, and pneumothorax.
vital_signs: BP: 140/90 mmHg, HR: 115 BPM, SpO2: 90%, RR: 30/min, Temp: 37.0°C
visual_prompt: Constricted bronchial tubes with thick magenta inflammation layers and jagged spikes of air resistance.
visuals_inspirations: Adapted from BioLabs Respiratory physiology, rephrasing obstruction as a high-contrast physical blockage.

treatment.title: Bronchodilators
treatment.desc: Short-acting beta-agonists (SABA) via nebulizer or MDI.

treatment.title: Corticosteroids
treatment.desc: Systemic steroids to reduce airway inflammation during the acute phase.

label: Severe Dehydration
description: Critical loss of body water and electrolytes disrupting metabolic functions.
causes: Sweating, vomiting, diarrhea, or insufficient intake.
emergency: Coma, very low blood pressure, or rapid, weak pulse.
complications: Kidney failure, heat injury, and seizures from electrolyte imbalance.
vital_signs: BP: 90/60 mmHg, HR: 120 BPM, SpO2: 97%, RR: 22/min, Temp: 38.2°C
visual_prompt: Shriveled cells in a dry, desert-like interstitial space with red-hot heat ripples and sodium-excess sparks.
visuals_inspirations: Derived from BioLabs Cellular Hydration, rephrasing fluid loss as a structural cellular collapse.

treatment.title: Fluid Resuscitation
treatment.desc: Rapid IV infusion of isotonic saline or Ringer's Lactate.

treatment.title: Electrolyte Correction
treatment.desc: Monitor and replace sodium, potassium, and magnesium cautiously.

label: Hypoglycemia
description: Dangerously low blood sugar levels that can lead to immediate loss of brain function.
causes: Excess insulin, skipping meals, or extreme exercise.
complications: Brain damage, coma, and sudden death if untreated.
vital_signs: BP: 100/60 mmHg, HR: 110 BPM, SpO2: 98%, RR: 20/min, Temp: 36.2°C
visual_prompt: Empty glucose carriers on a neuron membrane flickering between dim red and black as neural energy fails.
visuals_inspirations: Based on BioLabs Neuroplasticity energy panels, rephrasing low fuel as a flickering signal system.

treatment.title: Rapid Glucose
treatment.desc: Oral glucose tablets or high-sugar fruit juice if conscious.

treatment.title: Glucagon
treatment.desc: Subcutaneous or IM glucagon if patient is unconscious.
